decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to quickly set up a powerful combo using cards like Show and Tell, Omniscience, and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn. By cheating out Emrakul onto the battlefield for free, the player can quickly overwhelm their opponent with its powerful abilities and massive body. The deck includes a variety of card draw and countermagic spells to help find and protect the combo pieces, while also providing ways to tutor for key cards when needed. This deck aims to win the game in a single explosive turn with its powerful combo.

This BUG Control deck focuses on utilizing a variety of removal and counter spells to control the board while generating card advantage through cards like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Yorion, Sky Nomad. The deck also includes threats like Murktide Regent and Troll of Khazad-dûm to pressure the opponent while disrupting their game plan with cards such as Sheoldred's Edict and Abrupt Decay. The mana base is designed to support the deck's multicolor requirements and includes utility lands like Wasteland and Mystic Sanctuary.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while applying pressure with efficient creatures. The main strategy is to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, while using counterspells like Daze and Force of Will to protect your threats. Thoughtseize and Nihil Spellbomb are used to disrupt the opponent's hand and graveyard. The deck's key strength lies in its ability to quickly establish board presence and keep the opponent on the back foot, ultimately winning the game through tempo advantage and relentless aggression.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying powerful Eldrazi creatures to overwhelm the opponent and disrupt their game plan. By utilizing mana acceleration, efficient threats, and disruptive cards like Chalice of the Void, the deck aims to apply constant pressure and control the game tempo. The inclusion of versatile spells like Kozilek's Command and aggressive creatures like Thought-Knot Seer allows the deck to adapt to various matchups and effectively combat opposing strategies. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the Eldrazi theme and ensure consistent access to the necessary colors and resources.

The main idea of this deck is to control the board and the opponent's resources using a combination of counter spells, removal, and card draw. The deck focuses on setting up a strong defense with cards like Leyline Binding and Solitude, while also establishing card advantage with cards like Brainstorm and Intuition. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for additional value by flickering other permanents on the battlefield. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and disrupt their game plan until it can establish a winning position.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize the Death & Taxes archetype in an aggressive way, focusing on disruption and mana denial while also maintaining a strong board presence through versatile creatures. The inclusion of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion adds additional value and flexibility to the deck. By combining powerful removal spells like Swords to Plowshares with disruptive creatures like Skyclave Apparition and Flickerwisp, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while applying pressure and controlling the game tempo. Additionally, the use of Aether Vial allows for efficient creature deployment and mana acceleration.

The main concept of this deck is to establish early board control and disrupt the opponent's game plan through a combination of disruptive spells like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will. The deck aims to quickly close out the game by utilizing aggressive creatures such as Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Troll of Khazad-dûm, while also using cards like Reanimate to bring back threats from the graveyard. The inclusion of powerful tempo cards like Brazen Borrower and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student allow for additional versatility and card advantage in order to maintain pressure on the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly establish board presence and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures. By utilizing cards like Archon of Emeria, Seasoned Dungeoneer, and Simian Spirit Guide, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With powerful cards like Solitude and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, this deck can quickly push for damage and secure victory. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Swords to Plowshares and The One Ring to further control the battlefield and ensure dominance.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy by using cards like Thoughtseize and Skyclave Apparition, while also pushing for a fast and aggressive gameplay with cards like Reanimate and Swords to Plowshares. The deck also aims to control the board with creatures like Solitude and Troll of Khazad-dûm, and generate value using cards like Overlord of the Balemurk and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive gameplay while also providing access to necessary colors for spells and abilities.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently cheat out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Omniscience by using cards like Show and Tell and Cunning Wish. With the ability to disrupt opponent's strategies with cards like Hullbreacher and Chalice of the Void, while also having protection with Force of Will, this deck aims to overwhelm and outpace opponents in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches. The inclusion of cards like Silundi Vision and Intuition allows for card selection and finding key pieces of the combo quickly, making it a formidable force in the format.

The deck focuses on quickly milling through the entire library to win the game in one explosive turn. By using powerful combo pieces like Balustrade Spy and Undercity Informer to mill the entire library, followed by using Dread Return to bring back Thassa's Oracle to win the game instantly. The deck also includes various means of fast mana acceleration like Lotus Petal and rituals to speed up the combo. It also includes disruption like Thoughtseize and Unmask to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combo of Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill an opponent's entire library. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provide support and card advantage. The deck also includes mana accelerants like Lotus Petal and Mox Opal, as well as disruption spells like Force of Will and Metallic Rebuke. The artifact package is supported by Urza's Saga and Mishra's Bauble, with Thoughtcast and Stock Up providing card draw. The deck aims to control the game with a fast combo finish.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently reanimate powerful creatures such as Griselbrand, Archon of Cruelty, and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn using spells like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead. This combo-heavy strategy aims to rapidly bring back these high impact creatures onto the battlefield, overwhelming the opponent and securing a quick victory. The deck also includes disruption spells like Cabal Therapy and Thoughtseize to control the opponent's game plan and ensure a smooth reanimation process. With a mix of acceleration, disruption, and powerful threats, this deck aims to dominate the game from the start.

Utilize a combination of powerful creatures and spells to reanimate key threats from the graveyard, while using disruptive elements like counterspells and hand disruption to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck focuses on quickly and efficiently getting your threats onto the battlefield and overwhelming your opponent with powerful creatures that can close out the game quickly. Additionally, the deck also includes ways to generate card advantage and filter through your deck to find the pieces you need to execute your game plan effectively.

This deck aims to quickly dump powerful creatures into the graveyard and then bring them back onto the battlefield using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. By combining fast mana acceleration with disruptive control elements like Daze and Force of Will, the deck can successfully reanimate threatening creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The inclusion of cards like Brainstorm and Ponder help ensure consistency in drawing into the necessary combo pieces, while cards like Thoughtseize and Brazen Borrower help disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck's goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful reanimated threats while controlling the game tempo.

The main idea behind this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Troll of Khazad-dûm, Archon of Cruelty, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm. Then, the player can use spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring these creatures back onto the battlefield for a strong and fast offensive push. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces and ensure they can execute their game plan effectively. Additionally, there are versatile creatures like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent to provide additional threats and disruption.
